verdict.rationale: Gram documents least-privilege access for agent connections: team, server and tool-level permissions enforced through RBAC and OAuth 2.1, synced to the enterprise IdP. A customer example describes scoping per server, per tool and per team. However, the evidence never shows the product issuing distinct agent credentials such as scoped API keys or tokens; scoping is tied to IdP identity and roles. Missing for 10: documented issuance of agent-specific API keys/tokens, per-credential scope selection, credential expiry/rotation/revocation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
